faq.heading: A few things before playtime.
faq.body: Choosing, ordering and getting ready to play.

questions.question: How do I choose the right toy?
questions.answer: Start with what they enjoy: puzzles, building, art or imaginative play. Check the toy’s age guidance before choosing.

questions.question: Can play support focus and patience?
questions.answer: Matching a pattern or trying a puzzle gives children opportunities to stay with a task and try again. Follow their pace and keep play enjoyable; outcomes vary.

questions.question: Which toys work without batteries?
questions.answer: Many puzzles, art activities and building sets work without batteries. Check each product’s power requirements and included accessories.

questions.question: What comes in the box?
questions.answer: Contents vary by product. Check the listing for pieces, accessories and any batteries needed. Ask us if anything is unclear before ordering.

questions.question: Can you help me choose a gift?
questions.answer: Tell us the child’s age, interests and your budget, and we can help you compare suitable options. Follow the manufacturer’s age guidance.
